notes: The audit's numbers were taken by a harness outside the repository whose cases were not recorded. The cases of this benchmark are defined in tests/bench and match them in kind and size, not necessarily in shape.
No reference number was recorded as taken on an idle host. The figures marked "sandbox" come from a shared sandbox whose load was not recorded at the time; treat them as indicative.
Scene preparation: every activity followed by every other, node boxes on a grid without routes (as the graph-size tests); with self-loops, the first flow of every activity repeats the activity.

Simplification: the seeded cyclic family of the test generators (a ring, half as many random chords, self-loops on up to a third of the activities), seed 1. The earlier figures used another seeded cyclic graph with a self-loop on every activity.

Canvas: the renderer's own draw time (CanvasRenderer.lastDraw.ms) on a 1280 × 800 canvas at device pixel ratio 1, during gestures of six frames panned by a pixel; the default budget is the map's adaptive one, timed once it has settled: the warm-up goes on until a gesture draws as many flows as the one before (at most eight more gestures), and a range of flows drawn means it had not. Headless Chromium draws without a GPU, and rasterisation after the draw call is not included.
React map: from render to the end of the first draw (Canvas) or the frame in which React Flow shows its nodes, on a 1280 × 800 map with default props; layered family, grid positions with routes.

First scene: the map without positions, ELK and Dagre in their workers, reduced motion (the layout replaces the first scene without animation). Sparse is the layered family; dense has 20 flows per activity between random pairs.
Abort: a layout of the dense 500-activity graph in the ELK worker, aborted 250 ms after the worker started.
Memory: scripts/scene-memory.mjs (sparse chain with routes, heap after collection), a fresh process per size and trial; per activity and per flow are slopes between two sizes.
